1	---
     2	name: frontend-design
     3	description: Expert frontend design guidelines for creating beautiful, modern UIs. Use when building landing pages, dashboards, or any user interface.
     4	metadata: {"clawdbot":{"emoji":"🎨"}}
     5	---
     6	
     7	# Frontend Design Skill
     8	
     9	Use this skill when creating UI components, landing pages, dashboards, or any frontend design work.
    10	
    11	## Design Workflow
    12	
    13	Follow this structured approach for UI design:
    14	
    15	1. **Layout Design** — Think through component structure, create ASCII wireframes
    16	2. **Theme Design** — Define colors, fonts, spacing, shadows
    17	3. **Animation Design** — Plan micro-interactions and transitions
    18	4. **Implementation** — Generate the actual code
    19	
    20	### 1. Layout Design
    21	
    22	Before coding, sketch the layout in ASCII format:
    23	
    24	```
    25	┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
    26	│         HEADER / NAV BAR            │
    27	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    28	│                                     │
    29	│            HERO SECTION             │
    30	│         (Title + CTA)               │
    31	│                                     │
    32	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    33	│   FEATURE   │  FEATURE  │  FEATURE  │
    34	│     CARD    │   CARD    │   CARD    │
    35	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    36	│            FOOTER                   │
    37	└─────────────────────────────────────┘
    38	```
    39	
    40	### 2. Theme Guidelines
    41	
    42	**Color Rules:**
    43	- NEVER use generic bootstrap-style blue (#007bff) — it looks dated
    44	- Prefer oklch() for modern color definitions
    45	- Use semantic color variables (--primary, --secondary, --muted, etc.)
    46	- Consider both light and dark mode from the start
    47	
    48	**Font Selection (Google Fonts):**
    49	```
    50	Sans-serif: Inter, Roboto, Poppins, Montserrat, Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, Space Grotesk
    51	Monospace: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Source Code Pro, IBM Plex Mono, Space Mono, Geist Mono
    52	Serif: Merriweather, Playfair Display, Lora, Source Serif Pro, Libre Baskerville
    53	Display: Architects Daughter, Oxanium
    54	```
    55	
    56	**Spacing & Shadows:**
    57	- Use consistent spacing scale (0.25rem base)
    58	- Shadows should be subtle — avoid heavy drop shadows
    59	- Consider using oklch() for shadow colors too
    60	
    61	### 3. Theme Patterns
    62	
    63	**Modern Dark Mode (Vercel/Linear style):**
    64	```css
    65	:root {
    66	  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
    67	  --foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0);
    68	  --primary: oklch(0.205 0 0);
    69	  --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0 0);
    70	  --secondary: oklch(0.970 0 0);
    71	  --muted: oklch(0.970 0 0);
    72	  --muted-foreground: oklch(0.556 0 0);
    73	  --border: oklch(0.922 0 0);
    74	  --radius: 0.625rem;
    75	  --font-sans: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
    76	}
    77	```
    78	
    79	**Neo-Brutalism (90s web revival):**
    80	```css
    81	:root {
    82	  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
    83	  --foreground: oklch(0 0 0);
    84	  --primary: oklch(0.649 0.237 26.97);
    85	  --secondary: oklch(0.968 0.211 109.77);
    86	  --accent: oklch(0.564 0.241 260.82);
    87	  --border: oklch(0 0 0);
    88	  --radius: 0px;
    89	  --shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px hsl(0 0% 0%);
    90	  --font-sans: DM Sans, sans-serif;
    91	  --font-mono: Space Mono, monospace;
    92	}
    93	```
    94	
    95	**Glassmorphism:**
    96	```css
    97	.glass {
    98	  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    99	  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
   100	  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
   101	  border-radius: 1rem;
   102	}
   103	```
   104	
   105	### 4. Animation Guidelines
   106	
   107	**Micro-syntax for planning:**
   108	```
   109	button: 150ms [S1→0.95→1] press
   110	hover: 200ms [Y0→-2, shadow↗]
   111	fadeIn: 400ms ease-out [Y+20→0, α0→1]
   112	slideIn: 350ms ease-out [X-100→0, α0→1]
   113	bounce: 600ms [S0.95→1.05→1]
   114	```
   115	
   116	**Common patterns:**
   117	- Entry animations: 300-500ms, ease-out
   118	- Hover states: 150-200ms
   119	- Button press: 100-150ms
   120	- Page transitions: 300-400ms
   121	
   122	### 5. Implementation Rules
   123	
   124	**Tailwind CSS:**
   125	```html
   126	<!-- Import via CDN for prototypes -->
   127	<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
   128	```
   129	
   130	**Flowbite (component library):**
   131	```html
   132	<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
   133	<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.js"></script>
   134	```
   135	
   136	**Icons (Lucide):**
   137	```html
   138	<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>
   139	<script>lucide.createIcons();</script>
   140	```
   141	
   142	**Images:**
   143	- Use real placeholder services: Unsplash, placehold.co
   144	- Never make up image URLs
   145	- Example: `https://images.unsplash.com/photo-xxx?w=800&h=600`
   146	
   147	### 6. Responsive Design
   148	
   149	Always design mobile-first and responsive:
   150	
   151	```css
   152	/* Mobile first */
   153	.container { padding: 1rem; }
   154	
   155	/* Tablet */
   156	@media (min-width: 768px) {
   157	  .container { padding: 2rem; }
   158	}
   159	
   160	/* Desktop */
   161	@media (min-width: 1024px) {
   162	  .container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
   163	}
   164	```
   165	
   166	### 7. Accessibility
   167	
   168	- Use semantic HTML (header, main, nav, section, article)
   169	- Include proper heading hierarchy (h1 → h2 → h3)
   170	- Add aria-labels to interactive elements
   171	- Ensure sufficient color contrast (4.5:1 minimum)
   172	- Support keyboard navigation
   173	
   174	### 8. Component Design Tips
   175	
   176	**Cards:**
   177	- Subtle shadows, not heavy drop shadows
   178	- Consistent padding (p-4 to p-6)
   179	- Hover state: slight lift + shadow increase
   180	
   181	**Buttons:**
   182	- Clear visual hierarchy (primary, secondary, ghost)
   183	- Adequate touch targets (min 44x44px)
   184	- Loading and disabled states
   185	
   186	**Forms:**
   187	- Clear labels above inputs
   188	- Visible focus states
   189	- Inline validation feedback
   190	- Adequate spacing between fields
   191	
   192	**Navigation:**
   193	- Sticky header for long pages
   194	- Clear active state indication
   195	- Mobile-friendly hamburger menu
   196	
   197	---
   198	
   199	## Quick Reference
   200	
   201	| Element | Recommendation |
   202	|---------|---------------|
   203	| Primary font | Inter, Outfit, DM Sans |
   204	| Code font | JetBrains Mono, Fira Code |
   205	| Border radius | 0.5rem - 1rem (modern), 0 (brutalist) |
   206	| Shadow | Subtle, 1-2 layers max |
   207	| Spacing | 4px base unit (0.25rem) |
   208	| Animation | 150-400ms, ease-out |
   209	| Colors | oklch() for modern, avoid generic blue |
   210	
   211	---
   212	
   213	*Based on SuperDesign patterns — https://superdesign.dev*

1	# IdeaForum — Page Not Found
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	
     5	IdeaForum is an educational conference and talks platform that brings together thought leaders, educators, and curious minds to share ideas that shape the future. The 404 error page maintains the brand's minimal, professional aesthetic while guiding lost visitors back to meaningful content.
     6	
     7	Brand colors: #EB0028 (primary red), #121212 (dark text), #FFFFFF (background white)
     8	
     9	Tone: Minimal, professional, and helpful. The page should feel clean and uncluttered, with a calm, reassuring voice that acknowledges the error without alarm.
    10	
    11	## Hero Logo
    12	
    13	The IdeaForum wordmark logo is displayed prominently at the top center of the page. The logo uses the brand's primary red color and features a stylized treatment where the missing "E" in the middle is represented as a dashed outline — a clever visual nod to the "not found" concept. The logo should be large and serve as the primary visual anchor of the page.
    14	
    15	## Error Details
    16	
    17	- **Apology message:** Sorry, we can't find that.
    18	- **Helpful suggestion:** Perhaps we can help you find the content you're looking for:
    19	- **Error code:** HTTP Error 404
    20	- **Next steps heading:** What's next?
    21	- **Navigation link 1:** Go to the homepage → links to IdeaForum homepage
    22	- **Navigation link 2:** Visit our Help Desk → links to IdeaForum Help Desk
    23	
    24	## Search
    25	
    26	A search input field is displayed between the error message and the error code, allowing users to search for the content they were originally seeking.
    27	
    28	- Placeholder text: "Search IdeaForum..."
    29	- The field includes a search icon button (magnifying glass) aligned to the right inside the input
    30	- On submission, the user is directed to search results for their query
    31	- Input style: bordered field with subtle rounded corners, consistent with the minimal design
    32	
    33	## Error Code
    34	
    35	Displayed in a muted, light gray background bar below the search field:
    36	
    37	- Text: **HTTP Error 404**
    38	- Font: subdued, smaller weight than the main error message
    39	- A horizontal divider/rule appears below the error code to visually separate it from the next steps section
    40	
    41	## Next Steps
    42	
    43	A short section with the heading **"What's next?"** followed by two text links:
    44	
    45	1. **Go to the homepage** — navigates the user to the IdeaForum main landing page
    46	2. **Visit our Help Desk** — navigates the user to the IdeaForum support and help center
    47	
    48	Links should be styled in a muted/gray tone (approximately #777777) to maintain the minimal aesthetic, with an underline or hover state for accessibility.
    49	
    50	## Cookie Consent Banner
    51	
    52	A cookie consent banner appears at the bottom of the page on first visit:
    53	
    54	- **Message:** This website utilizes technologies such as cookies to enable essential site functionality, as well as for analytics, personalization, and targeted advertising. To learn more, view the following link:
    55	- **Privacy link:** Privacy Policy (opens in a new window)
    56	- **Action button:** Manage Preferences — opens a modal or panel allowing the user to configure cookie and privacy preferences
    57	
    58	## Layout & Design Notes
    59	
    60	- **Page structure:** Single-column, vertically centered layout on a white (#FFFFFF) background
    61	- **Responsive:** The layout should adapt gracefully to mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports
    62	- **Dark mode:** Not required
    63	- **Typography:** Clean sans-serif typeface; primary text in near-black (#121212), secondary/supporting text in medium gray (#444444 to #696969), links in light gray (#777777)
    64	- **Spacing:** Generous whitespace around all elements to reinforce the minimal, uncluttered feel
    65	- **Visual hierarchy:** Logo → Error message → Search → Error code → Next steps, flowing top to bottom with clear separation between sections

steps.message:
The IdeaForum 404 error page has been built and saved to `/app/output/index.html`. Here's a summary of what was implemented:

### Layout & Structure
- **Single-column, vertically centered layout** on a white background with generous whitespace
- **Mobile-first responsive design** that adapts gracefully to tablet and desktop
- Clean visual hierarchy: Logo → Error message → Search → Error code → Next steps

### Key Elements
1. **Hero Logo** — The IdeaForum wordmark with a clever dashed-outline "E" (a visual nod to "not found"), rendered in brand red (#EB0028)
2. **Error Message** — "Sorry, we can't find that." as the primary heading, with a helpful subline
3. **Search Input** — Prominent, centered search field with a magnifying glass icon button, focus states, and functional form submission
4. **Error Code** — "HTTP Error 404" displayed in a muted gray background pill
5. **Next Steps** — "What's next?" section with two underlined hover-link recovery options (Homepage, Help Desk)

### Cookie Consent Banner
- **Bottom-fixed banner** with the required message, Privacy Policy link, and "Manage Preferences" button
- **Preferences modal** that slides up (mobile) or fades in centered (desktop) with toggle switches for:
  - Essential (required, locked on)
  - Analytics
  - Personalization
  - Targeted Advertising
- Banner state persists in `localStorage` after dismissal

### Design System (per skill guidelines)
- **Font**: Inter (Google Fonts)
- **Colors**: oklch-inspired semantic palette using the brand colors (#EB0028, #121212, #FFFFFF) with supporting grays
- **Micro-interactions**: Smooth hover states, button press feedback, focus rings, slide-in animations for banner and modal
- **Accessibility**: Semantic HTML, ARIA labels, keyboard navigation (Escape to close modal), proper heading hierarchy, sufficient contrast
